name: node
correction: An earlier version of this file asserted ownedByWorkerB: true. That was WRONG and is corrected here. Worker B's own 'npm run dev' launch failed with 'Error: Port 8080 is already in use' (see scratchpad dev-err.log), proving PID 100416 was already listening before Worker B started. Worker B did NOT start this process and must NOT stop it. Per the brief, Worker B reused the existing server on 8080 rather than starting a second one.

workerBStartAttempt.error: Error: Port 8080 is already in use
workerBStartAttempt.consequence: no Worker B dev-server process exists; nothing for Worker B to clean up on port 8080

cleanupObligation: none for this PID; Worker B leaves it running for its owner
